svg.title: Indiscipline — October 16, 2026 — Reggies
svg.desc: A Chicago tribute to King Crimson performing In the Court of the Crimson King, with Mare Crisium opening. Doors at 7 PM, music at 8 PM, age 21 and over. Original wordmark, emblem and QR regions are reused from the band's original poster. The QR destination has not been independently decoded.

g.text: A CHICAGO TRIBUTE TO KING CRIMSON
